sick.title: Report an absence
sick.intro: Tell the OGS that your child will not attend care on the selected days. Their OGS registration remains unchanged.
sick.kindHintSick: For days when your child is ill. The OGS sees the sick note immediately.
sick.kindHintSickUnknown: For sick days. The OGS receives your sick note.
sick.kindHintExcused: For appointments or other planned absences. Briefly state the reason.
sick.kindHintExcusedUnknown: For appointments or other absences. Enter the reason.
sick.daysCount: {count, plural, one {Your child will be reported absent for this day.} other {Your child will be reported absent for # days.}}
sick.requestDaysCount: You are requesting an absence for the selected days.
sick.unknownDaysCount: {count, plural, one {One day is selected.} other {# days are selected.}}
sick.reasonPlaceholder: For example, fever or a medical appointment
sick.invalidDate: Please pick a valid date. The end date must not be before the start date.
sick.submittedButRefreshFailed: The absence was submitted but could not be displayed. Please reload the page.
sick.overlapError: One of these days already has an open absence request.
sick.submitSick: Send sick note to the OGS
sick.reasonRequiredError: Enter a short note for the OGS.
sick.requestSentBody: The OGS must still confirm the absence. Until then, your child is still expected.

pickup.title: Change pick-up time
pickup.intro: Request a different pick-up time for one day. The regular weekly plan remains unchanged. The change applies only after the OGS confirms it.
pickup.reasonPlaceholder: For example, a medical appointment or early pick-up
pickup.reasonRequired: Briefly state why the pick-up time is changing.
pickup.reasonTooLong: The reason may contain at most 255 characters.
pickup.loadError: The currently saved times could not be loaded. Please reload the page and try again.
pickup.errorDisabled: Changing the pickup time is not enabled for this school.
pickup.errorStaffConflict: The school has already set a special pick-up time for this day. Please contact the team.
pickup.errorRaced: This day was just changed. Please reload the page and try again.
pickup.errorPastDate: Changes cannot be saved for days in the past.
pickup.errorTooFar: That day is too far in the future. Please pick a day within the next two months.
pickup.staffSet: The school has already set a special pick-up time for this day: {pickup}.
pickup.alreadyHome: {name} is already home today. The pick-up time can no longer be changed.
pickup.alreadyHomeGeneric: Your child is already home today. The pick-up time can no longer be changed.
pickup.existingHint: A change is already set for {date}. Saving overwrites it.
pickup.cutoffHint: You can change today's pickup time until {time}.
pickup.cutoffClosed: Changes for today are only possible until {time}. Please contact the after-school care team. You can still change other days.
pickup.cutoffClosedGeneric: Today can no longer be changed. Please contact the after-school care team. You can still change other days.
pickup.resetDescription: The different pick-up time for {date} will be removed. The regular weekly plan applies again.
pickup.staleError: The request has changed in the meantime. Please reload the page.
pickup.statusApproved: Confirmed, the new pick-up time has been applied.
pickup.introWithMode: Request a different pick-up time or way home for one day. The weekly plan stays the same. The change applies only after the OGS confirms it.
pickup.noTimeOrMode: Enter a pick-up time or choose a way home.
pickup.reasonRequiredGeneric: Briefly state why the pick-up is changing.
pickup.pickupOptionalHint: Leave empty if the time stays the same.
pickup.modeStaffSet: The OGS has already set the way home for this day: {mode}.
pickup.statusApprovedChange: Confirmed, the change has been applied.
pickup.errorStaffConflictGeneric: The OGS has already set a change for this day. Please contact the team.
